options.text: Drive him away, tell him to go
options.resultText: The old man drew out his cane and magically snatched your wallet as punishment.
The old man gratefully accepted the food and shared his experience with you.

options.text: Ask him about the history of the neighborhood
options.resultText: The old man talks about her experiences and the history of the place, but it doesn't take long before you realize she's talking nonsense.
